name: DEFENSE (G)
shortDescription: Nutrient and bioagent-enriched organic fertilizer for stronger soil health and crop defense.
description: DEFENSE (G) supports nutrient availability, soil pH stability, water retention, and healthier soil structure while helping crops resist soil-borne pests and diseases.
benefits: Provides essential nutrients and beneficial bioagents.
Improves water-holding capacity and soil fertility.
Supports resistance against root grubs, termites, and root rot.
Adds organic carbon for healthier soil.
growthStage: Basal application and early vegetative stage

name: DEFENSE (P)
shortDescription: Bio-enriched organic manure that improves nutrient supply, moisture retention, and soil balance.
description: DEFENSE (P) is designed for broad soil application, helping stabilize pH, improve CEC, and support better root-zone health.
benefits: Supports nutrient supply for crop growth.

name: AZOIS
shortDescription: Azospirillum biofertilizer that fixes atmospheric nitrogen and supports root activity.
description: AZOIS contains Azospirillum species, a nitrogen-fixing biofertilizer used to improve soil fertility and plant growth while reducing dependency on chemical nitrogen.
benefits: Fixes atmospheric nitrogen near the root zone.
Promotes plant growth and stress tolerance.
Improves soil fertility and crop yield.
growthStage: Seedling, transplanting, and early vegetative stage

name: ECO HUMIC
shortDescription: Humic acid-based input that improves nutrient uptake, root development, and soil fertility.
description: ECO HUMIC is a concentrated humic formulation derived from decomposed organic matter, supporting nutrient chelation, root growth, and beneficial soil microbes.
growthStage: Root development and active vegetative growth

name: EVOLVE
shortDescription: Water-soluble specialized fertilizer for balanced growth, flowering, and stress resilience.
description: EVOLVE combines primary, secondary, and micronutrients including zinc and boron to promote vigorous growth, photosynthesis, and fruit and flower development.
growthStage: Vegetative growth, flowering, and fruit development

name: CALCIUM NITRATE
shortDescription: Water-soluble calcium and nitrogen source for crop growth, quality, and fruit development.
description: CALCIUM NITRATE provides readily available calcium and nitrogen, helping improve growth, branching, fruit development, and crop quality.
benefits: Supplies calcium for deficient or acidic soils.
Improves crop quality and shelf life.
Supports flowering, branching, and fruit development.
Suitable for cereals, vegetables, fruits, and legumes.
growthStage: Vegetative growth, flowering, and fruit setting

name: CAZOR
shortDescription: Acetobacter-based biofertilizer that supports nitrogen fixation in the root zone.
description: CAZOR uses Acetobacter bacteria to support atmospheric nitrogen fixation, soil fertility, and crop performance.
growthStage: Early vegetative and active growth stage

name: BORAX
shortDescription: Boron micronutrient for flowering, pollination, seed formation, and balanced growth.
description: BORAX supplies boron, a key micronutrient involved in cell division, flowering, pollen production, fruit setting, and nutrient translocation.
benefits: Improves flowering, pollen production, and seed formation.

name: SUPER MILA
shortDescription: Water-soluble mixture fertilizer with NPK and six micronutrients for fast uptake.
description: SUPER MILA is a water-soluble fertilizer containing NPK 12:11:18 plus zinc, manganese, iron, copper, boron, and molybdenum.
benefits: Supports foliar spray, fertigation, and soil application.
growthStage: Active growth, flowering, and fruit development

name: H98
shortDescription: Humic acid 98% for root development, soil structure, and nutrient availability.
description: H98 is a concentrated humic acid input that supports deeper roots, soil organic matter, CEC, water retention, and nutrient absorption.
benefits: Improves soil structure and water retention.
growthStage: Soil conditioning and root development stage
